en.tagline: Manage Baidu Drive files and back up agent memory
en.summary: A file manager for Baidu Drive (pan.baidu.com). It covers upload, download, transfer, share, search, move, copy, rename, create folder and delete, with all operations limited to the /apps/bdpan/ folder. On Kimiclaw, MaxClaw, QClaw and OpenClaw it can also back up and restore agent memory files to Baidu Drive.
problem: Users who store files in Baidu Drive often need to move, share or find them from inside an agent session. Doing this by hand means switching tools and copying paths.

With this skill, the agent runs the bdpan commands for these tasks. Write actions such as upload, delete, move and public share are shown first and run only after the user confirms with y. Memory backup and restore run through a script that checks paths and makes a safety copy before any restore.
fit: Uploading or downloading files to and from Baidu Drive from an agent session
Sharing a file with a link and extraction code, with a chosen expiry period
Backing up or restoring agent memory files on Kimiclaw, MaxClaw, QClaw or OpenClaw
unfit: Using other cloud drives such as OneDrive, Google Drive, Aliyun Drive or Quark Drive
Generating PPT files, which is handled by the separate baidu-wenku-aippt skill
steps: The skill runs only when the message names Baidu Drive explicitly, or asks for memory backup or restore; a bare word like "cloud drive" makes the agent ask which service is meant.
Before any bdpan command, it checks that bdpan is installed and that the user is logged in.
Remote paths are kept inside /apps/bdpan/, and paths containing .. or ~ are rejected.
Write operations such as upload, delete, move, rename, copy, download over an existing file and public share are listed with their scope and run only after the user confirms.
Large downloads over 50MB run in the background with nohup, and the agent reports progress until they finish.
Memory backup and restore go through memory-backup.sh, and restore shows the files it will overwrite and saves a copy of the current local memory first.

zh.tagline: 管理百度网盘文件，备份与恢复 Agent 记忆
zh.summary: 百度网盘（pan.baidu.com）文件管理工具，支持上传、下载、转存、分享、搜索、移动、复制、重命名、创建文件夹和删除。所有操作限定在 /apps/bdpan/ 目录内。在 Kimiclaw、MaxClaw、QClaw、OpenClaw 环境中，还可把 Agent 记忆文件备份到网盘或从网盘恢复。
problem: 在 Agent 对话中处理百度网盘文件时，通常需要切换工具，手动复制路径，操作繁琐。
使用本 Skill 后，Agent 直接执行对应的 bdpan 命令。上传、删除、移动、公开分享等写操作会先列出影响范围，用户输入 y 确认后才执行。记忆备份和恢复通过脚本完成，恢复前会检查路径并先保存当前本地记忆的副本。
fit: 在 Agent 对话中向百度网盘上传或下载文件
生成分享链接和提取码，并设置有效期
在 Kimiclaw、MaxClaw、QClaw 或 OpenClaw 上备份或恢复 Agent 记忆文件
unfit: 使用 OneDrive、Google Drive、阿里云盘、夸克网盘等其他云盘
生成 PPT，此功能由独立的 baidu-wenku-aippt skill 负责
steps: 只有消息明确提到百度网盘，或要求备份、恢复记忆时才会触发；只说“云盘”等泛称时，Agent 会先询问具体指哪一个服务。
执行任何 bdpan 命令前，先检查 bdpan 是否已安装，以及用户是否已登录。
远端路径限定在 /apps/bdpan/ 内，含 .. 或 ~ 的路径会被拒绝。
上传、删除、移动、重命名、复制、覆盖式下载和公开分享等写操作，会先列出范围，用户确认后才执行。
超过 50MB 的大文件在后台用 nohup 下载，Agent 持续报告进度直至完成。
记忆备份和恢复通过 memory-backup.sh 执行；恢复前会列出将被覆盖的文件，并先保存当前本地记忆的副本。
